import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    ans = 0
    n = len(s)
    
    i = 0
    while i <= n:
        if i >= n:
            break
        c = s[i]
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == c:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
